name: site-playbooks
description: Per-site usage-knowledge playbooks for browser-operating agents. A lookup command finds the playbook matching the domain or pattern of the target URL (most specific match wins) and prints its quirks, login flow, anti-bot notes, and reliable selector strategy; an add command validates new community playbooks and refuses duplicates; a lint check parses every playbook. Before any browser task, the agent runs lookup and applies the playbook. Playbooks are community-contributed and marked as such: verify before relying on them.
